metadata.Description: A manually annotated, multi-dialectal Arabic dataset for dangerous speech detection. Collected from Twitter using a curated lexicon of physical harm threats, it contains 5,011 tweets labeled as 'dangerous' or 'safe'.
metadata.Paper Title: Understanding and Detecting Dangerous Speech in Social Media
Affiliations: Natural Langauge Processing Lab, The University of British Columbia
